channel.title: Maple's Weekly Menu
channel.description: A weekly menu of recipe picks, curated for the Mela recipe app.

item.title: Sheet Pan Crispy Harissa Chicken with Smashed Potatoes, Labneh & Dill (Blue Apron)
item.description: Chicken breasts topped with a sweet and spicy harissa sauce plus breadcrumbs, roasted alongside crispy smashed baby potatoes. Finished with olives, tomatoes, dill, and a drizzle of labneh. (Blue Apron)

item.title: Truffle Chicken with Bacon and Goat Cheese Smothered Green Beans (Home Chef)
item.description: Seared chicken topped with truffle butter, served with green beans smothered in bacon, goat cheese, and crispy onions. (Home Chef)
